description: This file implements the RecordingManager class for managing video recording sources, starting/stopping recordings, and handling video source lifecycle within the WebRTC streaming context in the Cuttlefish project.

classes.name: RecordingManager
classes.description: Manages video recording sources, controls start/stop of recording, and handles source addition/removal within the WebRTC streaming environment.

methods.name: RecordingManager
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the RecordingManager with configuration details.

methods.name: AddSource
methods.description: Adds a new video source for recording, and starts recording if already active.

methods.name: RemoveSource
methods.description: Removes a video source and stops its recording if active.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts recording for all added sources.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops all ongoing recordings and clears recorder instances.

methods.name: WaitForSources
methods.description: Blocks until the specified number of sources are available.

methods.name: StartSingleRecorder
methods.description: Initializes and starts recording for a specific source label.
